---
title: "Service Delivery Study"
---

## Contract

- **Consultant:** Citygate Associates, LLC
- **Original agreement executed:** July 29, 2025
- **Signatories:** Karen Pinkos, City Manager; Chad Jackson, President, Citygate Associates
- **Proposed schedule (Citygate's own proposal):** "approximately six to eight months from contract execution."

::: {.source-note}
Source: *CITYGATE ASSOCIATES, LLC 2025.7.29-1.pdf*, Section 5.7, "Proposed Project Schedule." Contract execution date confirmed in *CITYGATE ASSOCIATES LLC Amendment 20260630.pdf*, Recital A.
:::

## Change Order #1

- **Dated:** December 11, 2025
- **Subject:** restructuring the Mid-Project Briefing from a single consolidated presentation into a high-level Citywide overview (December 16, 2025) plus seven separate department-level briefings (Administration, Community Development, Finance, Fire, Police, Public Works, Recreation)
- **Cost impact:** "will not exceed $4,945, inclusive of all hourly fees and our standard administration cost"
- **Signed by:** Karen Pinkos, December 11, 2025

::: {.source-note}
Source: *Citygate Associates CHANGE ORDER 2025.12.111.pdf*, letter to Karen Pinkos dated December 11, 2025.
:::

This change order was a scope refinement (more detailed departmental briefings), not a scope expansion or cost overrun in the traditional sense — Citygate itself notes it reduced other project-team participation to help offset the added cost.

## The Amendment

- **Dated:** June 30, 2026 — the exact day the original contract term expired
- **Substantive change:** one sentence — "Section 1.1 of the Agreement shall be amended such that the term of the Agreement shall be extended from June 30, 2026, to December 31, 2026."
- **Cost change:** none stated
- **Reason stated in the amendment:** none — the document contains no explanation for the extension beyond the single sentence changing the end date

::: {.source-note}
Source: *CITYGATE ASSOCIATES LLC Amendment 20260630.pdf*, full text of the amendment (one page).
:::

## Timeline Summary

| Date | Event |
|---|---|
| July 29, 2025 | Original contract executed |
| — | Proposed duration: 6–8 months (per Citygate's own proposal) |
| Dec 11, 2025 | Change Order #1: briefing structure revised, +$4,945 |
| June 30, 2026 | Original contract term expires — same day, amendment signed extending to Dec 31, 2026, no reason stated |
| Dec 31, 2026 | New contract end date |

From execution (July 2025) to the new end date (December 2026) is **17 months** — more than double Citygate's own original 6–8 month estimate.

## Relationship to the State Auditor Recommendation

This is the organizational/staffing study the State Auditor recommended the City complete **by September 2021**, as the first step before any compensation study. See the [Sequencing Case Study](sequencing-case-study.qmd) for the full comparison against the Auditor's recommended order — this contract was not executed until July 2025, nearly four years after that target date, and roughly three years after the City had already completed its compensation study.
